The details.

Quick answers about Turne, the waitlist, Premium and giveaways.

About Turne

What is Turne?

Turne is a platform for brand-hosted events where every startup gets its own room. You hop between rooms to watch demos, chat with founders, vote, upvote startups and enter giveaways.

What is a startup room?

A space inside an event that belongs to one startup, a bit like a server on Discord. It has a live demo, a chat, Q&A and polls, and it can run its own giveaway.

Can my startup get a room?

Rooms are opened by the brand hosting each event. If you'd like to showcase at an upcoming Turne event, write to brands@turne.in.

When is Turne launching?

Turne is preparing for launch. The countdown on our home page shows the planned launch timeline. Join the waitlist and you'll be first through the door.

Is Turne free?

The consumer experience will include a free tier. Premium features and benefits may vary as Turne launches and evolves.

Which cities can join?

Anyone in India can join the waitlist. Experiences will roll out city by city.

The waitlist

How do I join?

Verify your WhatsApp number with the 6-digit code we send, add your name, date of birth and city, then tap Join the waitlist. It takes well under a minute.

What do I get for joining?

The first 10,000 verified waitlist members receive Lifetime Premium membership.

Can I register more than one number?

Each WhatsApp number can hold one waitlist entry. If you register the same number again, you'll see your existing spot.

Will you share my number with brands?

No. We don't sell your personal information, and we don't share your phone number with brands or advertisers. See our privacy policy.

How do I stop WhatsApp messages?

Reply STOP to any message from us, or email privacy@turne.in. Withdrawing consent may mean we can't keep your waitlist entry or Premium eligibility active.

Premium and giveaways

What is Premium?

Premium is Turne's membership experience: additional benefits and access to selected opportunities. Premium benefits may evolve as Turne launches.

Do Premium members automatically win giveaways?

No. Premium does not guarantee winning. It provides access to the Premium allocation, a dedicated 50% share, of selected giveaway opportunities.

Do I have to pay to enter a giveaway?

No. Giveaways are free to enter for eligible members. There's no purchase, stake or wager of any kind.

Still stuck?

Write to hello@turne.in or send us a message and we'll get back to you.
